name: prod_mul_volume_inter_slab
summary: By volume_inter_slab_eq_signed_sum, vol(Ω ∩ slab k D) = C·vol(slab k D) with a constant C = Δ(id)/k!·Σ_τ sgn(τ)/Δ(τ) that depends only on k and q = P^N; nothing is divided by vol(slab k D), which may be 0, so the identity stays multiplicative. C is evaluated in the special case of one letter with parity true, P := q and D = 1: there the cone is an orthant in the coordinates β_l − qβ_{l+1}, and the linear map F with these coordinates rescaled by d_l = (q^{l+1} − 1)/(q − 1) maps its part of the slab onto the slab (it preserves the coordinate sum), so C·vol(slab k 1) = vol(slab k 1)/det F. The only volume cancelled is that of this one-letter test slab, shown positive and finite; hence C = 1/det F = 1/Π d_l, for every real P > 1.

steps.claim: N = 0 is excluded (NeZero); write N = m + 1.
Rewrite vol(Ω ∩ slab k D) by volume_inter_slab_eq_signed_sum.
Let d(i) = (P^{i+1} − 1)/(P − 1), p_c the coordinate (c, 0) for c < k (0 for c ≥ k), and F(β)(l, 0) = d(l)·(β(l, 0) − P·β(l+1, 0)), an endomorphism of ℝ^{Fin k × Fin 1}.

steps.lean:
have det : F.det = ∏ b : Fin k, d b := by
    rw [← det_toMatrix', ← det_reindex_self (prodUnique ..), det_of_isUpperTriangular]
      <;> simp [Fin.ext_iff, F, p, DFunLike.dite_apply, BlockTriangular]; lia
steps.typed_fact: F.det = ∏ b : Fin k, d b

steps.claim: The matrix of F is upper triangular with diagonal d(b).
steps.lean:
rw [← det_toMatrix', ← det_reindex_self (prodUnique ..), det_of_isUpperTriangular]
      <;> simp [Fin.ext_iff, F, p, DFunLike.dite_apply, BlockTriangular]; lia

steps.claim: Claim deg: Σ_b F(β)(b, 0) = Σ_b β(b, 0): the sum telescopes, since d(c+1) − 1 = P·d(c).
steps.lean:
have deg β : ∑ b, F β (b, 0) = ∑ b, β (b, 0) := sub_eq_zero.1 (by convert (sum_range_sub' (fun c ↦
    (d c - 1) * p c β) k) <;> simp [sum_range, F, p, ↓← sum_sub_distrib, -smul_dite] <;> grind)
have D0 : 0 < F.det := by simp [prod_pos, d, one_lt_pow₀, *]

steps.claim: The formula of volume_inter_slab_eq_signed_sum in the special case k, m = 0, P, v = true, D = 1 and Ω = pieriCone ⊤ P (its hypothesis hΩ holds by unfolding pieriCone).
steps.lean: have := @volume_inter_slab_eq_signed_sum k 0 P ⊤ q 1 (pieriCone ⊤ P) (by simp [pieriCone, field])

steps.claim: In that special formula, rewrite pieriCone ⊤ P ∩ slab k 1 as F⁻¹(slab k 1) (a set identity left as a goal), use vol(F⁻¹(X)) = vol(X)/|det F|, and cancel vol(slab k 1), which is positive (it contains the box [0, 1/k]^{Fin k × Fin 1}, whose coordinate sum is at most 1) and finite (bounded).
steps.lean:
erw [@Set.ext _ (_ ∩ _) (F ⁻¹' slab k 1), Measure.real, volume.addHaar_preimage_linearMap D0.ne',
    toReal_mul, mul_left_inj' (toReal_pos (mt (measure_mono_null (s := .Icc 0 (↑k)⁻¹) fun β ⟨h, g⟩ ↦
    ⟨h, by simp; grw [← h _, g _]; simp [mul_inv_le_one]⟩) (by simp [Real.volume_Icc_pi]))
    (Set.univ_inter _ ▸ isBounded_inter_slab ..).measure_lt_top.ne).ne', pow_one] at this

steps.claim: Hence the signed sum equals 1/det F = 1/Π d(b), and the claim follows: Π_l (P^l − 1)/(P − 1)·(1/Π d)·vol(slab) = vol(slab).
steps.lean: simp [↓← this, ← det, abs_of_nonneg, D0.le, field, d]; rfl

steps.claim: The set identity: unfold slab and pieriCone; the column sums agree by deg.
F(β) ≥ 0 coordinatewise iff β(l, 0) ≥ P·β(l+1, 0) for all l, and then β ≥ 0 follows by downward induction on the index (well-founded recursion for >).
steps.lean:
simpa [F, p, DFunLike.dite_apply, d, one_lt_pow₀, *] using fun β _ _ ↦ ⟨by bound, fun h ↦
    ⟨by grind, WellFoundedGT.fix fun b I ↦ (h b).trans' (by grind [mul_nonneg])⟩⟩
